title: timing / session.started (v1) data payload
description: The ACTUAL (physical) start of a session, emitted by Timing. Published to the 'timing.events' exchange with routing key 'session.started'. Consumers: Booking (reconcile plan vs actual), Leaderboard (auto-reset the board), Billing.

sessionId.description: The session that started. Same id space as lap.recorded.sessionId.

startedAt.description: When the session actually started. RFC3339 UTC, exactly 3-digit milliseconds, literal 'Z' (AR9). The pattern is enforced (format is annotation-only).
